caption: Figure 4.18: This ﬁgure illustrates the activation of a runnable with a minimum start interval. The started state of the runnable main states and the debounce activation and activated states of the runnable activation states are shown. Each ﬂash indicates the occurrence of an RTE event. The red arrows indicate the minimum start interval after each start of the runnable. An RTE event within this minimum start interval leads to the debounce activation state. When the minimum start interval ends, the debounce activation state changes to the activated state.
